"""Prepare a source-only uncertainty proposal; never select a detector output."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess

import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

ROOT = Path.cwd()
DOC = ROOT / 'docs/50-diagnostics/s11'
OUT = ROOT / 'sample/output/s11-upper-projection-reference-20261010-001'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
load = lambda p: json.loads(Path(p).read_text())


def save(path, value):
    Path(path).write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) + '\n')


assert not OUT.exists()
OUT.mkdir(parents=True)
relation = load(DOC / '2026-10-10-water-surface-feature-reply.json')
old = load(DOC / '2026-10-10-water-foam-representation.json')
capture_path = ROOT / 'sample/output/s11-water-foam-support-20261010-002/f001438.npz'
stages_path = ROOT / 'sample/output/s11-water-foam-support-20261010-002/stages/f001438.npz'
source_path = ROOT / relation['source_raster']['path']
inputs = [source_path, capture_path, stages_path,
          DOC / '2026-10-10-water-surface-feature-reply.json',
          DOC / '2026-10-10-upper-projection-choice.json',
          DOC / '2026-10-10-water-foam-representation.json']
pre = dict(
    schema='s11-upper-projection-reference-preparation-v1',
    base_head=subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip(),
    purpose='Prepare the first source-bound interval review under the selected upper-image-projection rule. No detector trial or scalar score.',
    inputs={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): sha(p) for p in inputs},
    source_case=dict(case_id=relation['case_id'], video=relation['video'],
                     video_sha256=relation['video_sha256'], frame_index=1438,
                     nominal_time_sec=1438 * 1001 / 30000,
                     source_raster=relation['source_raster']),
    rule_id='fixed-center-upper-image-projection-v1',
    source_region_xyxy=[740, 250, 1160, 1080],
    detail_xyxy=[840, 450, 1070, 540],
    reference_proposal=dict(
        source_x=950, source_pixel_rows_inclusive=[484, 489],
        source_y_interval=[483.5, 489.5],
        semantics='Uncertainty about one upper-projection coordinate at this column, not a physical layer, a dense contour mask, or acceptance of all other edges in the interval. Half-pixel endpoints are row-cell bounds, not claimed subpixel accuracy.',
        authority='Agent source-visual proposal only; pending human review.',
        selection_basis='Native source inspection at the existing diagnostic X. The previous Canny rows were already exposed; this is not blinded or holdout annotation. No candidate prediction/error or detector success rate determined the interval.',
        geometry_status='DIAGNOSTIC_CROP_CENTER_ONLY',
        calibration='No zero line or mm/px calibration assigned.',
        review_status='PENDING_HUMAN_INTERVAL_REVIEW'),
    control_scope='B/f1438 only. Keep all existing water/beer/milk/target controls and legacy cases at their own scopes; no interval or front/back relation transfers to C or neighbours.',
    readout='Retain all existing Canny centre rows and all existing support-face crossings, including censorship. Interval hits are representation availability only, not chosen physical pixels.',
    stop_rule='Do not install this interval as executable truth or use it for scalar efficacy until the user reviews its source meaning. Unclear leaves it unqualified; no window/threshold repair follows.',
    windows_required=False, production_change=False, formal_label_change=False,
    runner_sha256=sha(__file__))
save(OUT / 'preflight.json', pre)
(OUT / 'run.py').write_bytes(Path(__file__).read_bytes())
for p in (capture_path, stages_path):
    assert sha(p) == old['local_artifacts'][str(p.relative_to(ROOT))]['sha256']
assert sha(source_path) == relation['source_raster']['sha256']
original = Image.open(source_path).convert('RGB')
whole = original.crop(tuple(pre['source_region_xyxy']))
detail = original.crop(tuple(pre['detail_xyxy'])).resize((920, 360), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
with np.load(capture_path, allow_pickle=False) as cap, np.load(stages_path, allow_pickle=False) as stages:
    assert np.array_equal(np.array(whole)[:, :, ::-1], cap['crop'])
    assert np.array_equal(stages['retained_labels'], cap['labels'])
    center_x, local_x = 950, 210
    canny_rows = (np.flatnonzero(stages['canny'][:, local_x]) + 250).tolist()
    visible_rows = (np.flatnonzero((stages['canny'][:, local_x] != 0) & cap['visible'][:, local_x]) + 250).tolist()
    start, end = cap['start_xy2'], cap['end_xy2']
    horizontal = start[:, 1] == end[:, 1]
    intersects = horizontal & (np.minimum(start[:, 0], end[:, 0]) <= 2 * center_x) & (2 * center_x <= np.maximum(start[:, 0], end[:, 0]))
    crossings = [dict(face_index=int(i), source_y=float(start[i, 1] / 2),
                      inside_label=int(cap['inside_label'][i]), outside_label=int(cap['outside_label'][i]),
                      status=int(cap['status'][i])) for i in np.flatnonzero(intersects)]
    lo, hi = pre['reference_proposal']['source_y_interval']
    readout = dict(
        all_canny_center_rows=canny_rows, visible_canny_center_rows=visible_rows,
        proposed_interval_canny_rows=[y for y in visible_rows if lo <= y <= hi],
        all_retained_appearance_crossings=crossings,
        proposed_interval_appearance_crossings=[r for r in crossings if lo <= r['source_y'] <= hi],
        proposed_interval_glare_rows=[int(y + 250) for y in np.flatnonzero(stages['glare'][:, local_x]) if lo <= y + 250 <= hi],
        interpretation='No interval hit certifies physical correspondence. These are unchanged raw edges and retained appearance faces, not Oil or Foam predictions.',
        physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED', numeric_truth_created=False)

bg, fg, muted = (17, 24, 32), (235, 240, 246), (172, 187, 204)
font = lambda n: ImageFont.truetype('/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf', n)
canvas = Image.new('RGB', (1440, 1040), bg)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
draw.text((24, 20), 'B | upper water projection: reference interval for review', font=font(29), fill=fg)
draw.text((24, 60), 'One surface / two projections is reviewed. The upper-projection rule is chosen. Pixel interval is unreviewed.', font=font(20), fill=muted)
draw.text((24, 108), 'Whole context (native pixels)', font=font(21), fill=fg)
canvas.paste(whole, (24, 148))
draw.text((480, 108), 'Clean source detail (4x nearest-neighbour)', font=font(21), fill=fg)
canvas.paste(detail, (480, 148))
draw.text((480, 553), 'At X950 only: proposed uncertainty in source rows 484-489', font=font(21), fill=fg)
canvas.paste(detail, (480, 598))
cx = 480 + (950 - 840 + 0.5) * 4
top, bottom = 598 + (484 - 450) * 4, 598 + (490 - 450) * 4
yellow, cyan = (255, 211, 83), (74, 220, 244)
for y in range(610, 950, 12):
    if top - 8 <= y <= bottom + 8:
        continue
    draw.line((cx, y, cx, y + 4), fill=cyan, width=1)
draw.rectangle((cx - 10, top, cx + 10, bottom), outline=yellow, width=2)
draw.line((cx + 12, (top + bottom) / 2, 1080, 649), fill=yellow, width=2)
draw.rounded_rectangle((1074, 610, 1380, 660), radius=8, fill=bg, outline=yellow, width=2)
draw.text((1086, 623), 'Proposed range (unreviewed)', font=font(19), fill=yellow)
draw.text((480, 979), 'A source-position uncertainty range, not layer thickness or detector output.', font=font(19), fill=muted)
image_path = DOC / '2026-10-10-upper-projection-reference-review.png'
assert not image_path.exists()
canvas.save(image_path)
back = Image.open(image_path).convert('RGB')
assert np.array_equal(back.crop((24, 148, 444, 978)), whole)
assert np.array_equal(back.crop((480, 148, 1400, 508)), detail)
for p, h in pre['inputs'].items():
    assert sha(ROOT / p) == h, p
record = dict(schema='s11-upper-projection-reference-preparation-v1', preflight=pre,
              preflight_sha256=sha(OUT / 'preflight.json'), readout=readout,
              image=dict(path=str(image_path.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=sha(image_path), size=list(back.size)),
              clean_panels_equal_source=True, saved_capture_equal=True, inputs_preserved=True,
              disposition='PENDING_HUMAN_INTERVAL_REVIEW', physical_decision='NOT_EVALUATED',
              script=Path(__file__).read_text(), local_preflight=str((OUT / 'preflight.json').relative_to(ROOT)))
save(DOC / '2026-10-10-upper-projection-reference.json', record)
print(json.dumps(dict(status='SOURCE_PREPARATION_VERIFIED', canny_count=len(canny_rows),
                      interval_canny_rows=readout['proposed_interval_canny_rows'], crossings=crossings,
                      review_status=record['disposition'])))
